sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor [n16112] (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding bundle the fastener kit with one distributor.
Our latest forecast for part:360010 grows +6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).
Today you supply 40 % of our need for this part, another approved source the rest. A binding 36-month commitment on these terms puts you first in line for a larger share.
The attached package gives you planning certainty over 36 months.
We understand your position on list prices, so we have structured the packages below around payment, contract length.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 30,000 complete bundles of part:360010, part:360011, part:360012, part:360030 per year over 36 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.59 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We appreciate the 36-month volume commitment and the positive forecast, which we have incorporated into our revised calculation.
Please note that as a distributor, our pricing is structured around list prices and volume discount tiers, so we are unable to provide a detailed cost breakdown.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 36 months: €5.52 per unit.
Material accounts for about 61 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €5.54 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
A few words on this from our side.
We have already taken that volume change data into account.
We have reviewed the forecast for part:360011, but as we already factored similar volume growth into our previous calculation, it does not alter our baseline.
Regarding your question about our discount tiers, a 36-month commitment qualifies for the next tier when combined with a 30-day payment term.
Taking up your offer to pay faster, we can reduce our price to €5.47 per unit in exchange for 30 days net payment over a 36-month contract.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C.
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
